t: You're looking at St Anne's House, at 363 Kennington Lane in Vauxhall. It's the presbytery for St Anne's Church, which stands right next door. It was designed by Joseph Gandy. Gandy was an English artist, visionary architect and architectural theorist, best known for his imaginative paintings of John Soane's designs. He worked closely with Soane as draughtsman and creative partner from 1798 until 1809, when he set up his own practice. So this modest house comes from the hand of a man famous for his imagination.
